content: Kila mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa jhojhoha uhaghulilwa na Chapanga kuhumii pakate jha bhando bhake na uhenga lihengo lya Chapanga kwa nhwalo gwabhe. Upiya hupo na matambiko kwa nhwalo gwa uhakaho gwa bhando.
Nhwalo jwenio ndi jwaleghele, ihoto kwakole kiya bhala bhangamanya kilebhe na bhibhahobholela na bhibhahenga uhakaho.
Na nhwalo jwenio ndi leghele, ipalwa kupiya Litambiko chi kwa nhwalo gwa bhando, nambo hele kwa uhakaho gwake jwenio.
Abhii jhe mundo jwahotola kukitenda jwenio abhabha Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa. Kila jhumo ihaghulilwa na Chapanga kubhehe mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa ngita chakibha Halune.
Jwenio Kilichitu, helahela akakitehi jwenio kubhehe Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa, nambo Chapanga nganobholila:

content.text: deleno jheno nilonge bhando bhoha bhamanye ne na Tate gwino.”

content: Helahela chehemo jhenge jha majhandiko ilonge,

content.text: “Mwenga ndi mpiya litambiko nkolongwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta,

content: Yecho patamita pamba pannema, ampembikiya na kunelela hake Chapanga kwa maholi chwii, jwahoto kughombola kubhoka mu kuwegha. Nhwalo akibha jwanuu na kunnyoghopa Chapanga, yenio ngannyinamila Chapanga.
Pamonga na kubhehe Mwana gwa Chapanga, akakibholite kujhokanikiya kupete malagho ghake.
Na pateilwa kubhehe ajhomwila lihengo lyakamwiwe na Chapanga, ajhakubhehe chembo cha ughombokeko gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta kwa bhala bhibhannyokanikiya,
na Chapanga ngahagwila kubhehe Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa ngita chakibha Melikichedeki.
Peniya, Tukwete twe gha kulonge mambu ghanga, nambo ndi unonopu kwalobholela, nhwalo mangota ndi akatotoho bha kukibhola.
Ngohe mipalwa kubhehe akabhola, nambo mangota mipala kabhele mundo ammola mabholo ghakutumbuu gha lilobhe lya Chapanga. Ngohe nhengelike mwojho mipala kujhonga na chi chakulyegha kijhundupaho.
Kila jwapalwa kujhonga mabhele ahoto jhe kuholela ghighanhalalii Chapanga, nhwalo jwenio amela mwana jwandina ko.
Nambo chakulya kijhundupaho kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhibhakomile, bhubhabhii na malango ghu kumanya ghambone na ghanganandela.
